predecessors.name: Principality of Rostov-Suzdal (Vladimir-Suzdal)
predecessors.text: Beloozero, which 'became independent in 1238 during the Mongol invasions of Kievan Rus'

successors.name: Grand Principality of Moscow
successors.text: Beloozero, administered by Ivan Kalita's namestniks 'instead of the princes' and 'subjugated by Muscovy' in 1389

ledger.x: 1238: Beloozero becomes an independent principality under Prince Gleb.
1343: the Beloozero country passes to Moscow's direct administration.
The principality ends as an independent state under Ivan Kalita's namestniks; the date is Cliopatria's.

certainty.note: The page gives the lake basins, not a boundary; the forest frontier with Novgorod and Vladimir-Suzdal is approximate throughout.
